Weyl_derivation: A normwise decomposition perturbation bounded by delta implies |sigma_i(candidate)-sigma_i(mathematical)|<=delta. Relative-cutoff function perturbation <=(1+1e-12)*delta. Combined normalization/decomposition budget is conservative; inverse conditioning is not hidden.
allowed_conservative_rejection: Certified mathematically eligible oracle + production wrapper rejects => CONSERVATIVE_NUMERICAL_SUPPORT_REJECTION; support loss, never null evidence.
ambiguity: Candidate-based margin, no response: any candidate |sigma-1e-12|<=2delta or |sigma-1e-12*sigma_max|<=2(1+1e-12)delta fails closed. Column scale threshold margin2gamma_(2n+5)*scale also fails closed. Oracle validates each accepted geometry independently.
ambiguity_diagnostics: Threshold ambiguity is numerical support rejection; oracle mathematical rank/eligibility still reported.
analytic_limit: gamma rounding budget supplies conservative margin conditional on normwise backward error. Oracle validates bound on every accepted fixture/actual geometry; no unsupported universal numerical safety theorem is claimed.
backward_error: For candidate accepted, reconstruct raw RD from candidate normalized*RMS; eta=norm(Z.T*RD,inf)/(norm(Z,F)*max(1,norm(D))). Require max(abs(Z.T*RD)) <1e-9*max(1,norm(D)) (same numerical ceiling prospectively retained, reliability only). Also require candidate singular-value discrepancies <=delta.
fail_nonambiguous_disagreement: Only unsafe acceptance blocks, conservative rejection counted toward support.
forward_error: Every accepted nonambiguous audited projection must satisfy max absolute normalized_RD error <=1e-7 versus stable oracle; directly checked, never inferred solely from orthogonality. High-precision validation is predictor-only and covers all eligible geometry before any worker authority.
geometry_bound: 5<=n<=23; finite inputs; no overflow/underflow accepted; fixed 100 maximum sweeps x3 pairs =300 rotations
hard_safety: Every wrapper accepted geometry must have both certified oracle precisions, mathematical eligibility, singular discrepancy<=delta, oracle normalized error<=1e-7 and RMS error<=1e-9*max(oracleRMS,1e-10). Any violation blocks V6; oracle output discrepancies must not silently turn an unsafe acceptance into conservative rejection.
oracle_eligibility: Mathematical eligibility after full oracle certification, regardless production acceptance.
principle: Production acceptance must be certified safe; mathematical eligibility does not compel production acceptance.
production_wrapper: UNCHANGED V4 candidate accepts AND finite scales/singulars/output AND threshold-separated AND independently reconstructed binary64 orthogonality<1e-9*max(1,normD); all other cases numerical support unavailable.
rounding_budget_K: K(n)=3*n+6 + 300*(6*n+32) + 12*n+30. Covers n-term RMS reductions and normalization, per-pair three n-term moments and row/vector rotation scalar arithmetic, then n-term sigma/pseudoinverse/residual reductions. Sum budgets via gamma composition; worst-case maximum sweeps, not observed sweep count.
spectral_error_radius: delta=gamma_K*norm(Z,F). Treat as prospective conservative diagnostic bound; must be independently verified against high precision for every audited geometry, not presumed proven for arbitrary inputs. Singular-value discrepancy above delta blocks.
